### Key columns

| Column | Description | Units |
|--------|-------------|-------|
| `PlotCode` | Unique plot identifier | — |
| `CensusNo` | Census number within a plot | — |
| `Tag` | Individual stem tag number | — |
| `DBH` | Diameter at breast height | cm |
| `Status` | Stem status at census | — |
